title: Secure first confirmed distribution partner
context: Elyos measures success as adoption by a named beneficiary. Until a named partner confirms they will host or use a specific explainer, all tasks carry verifiedNeed:false and requestor:'TO BE SECURED'. This task closes that gap by converting an outreach thread (outreach-007) into a first confirmed partner: a named school, OER network, newsroom, civic group, or portal with a specific explainer in scope.
objective: Secure the first confirmed distribution partner — a named beneficiary who commits to hosting or using a specific explainer — and update affected tasks with verifiedNeed:true and a named requestor.
acceptanceCriteria: A named beneficiary (school/OER network, newsroom, civic group, or civic portal) has confirmed in writing or on record that they will host or use a specific explainer.
The channel and acceptance evidence are documented (e.g. email confirmation, written agreement, or acceptance into an OER collection).
Affected task JSON files are updated with verifiedNeed:true and requestor set to the named beneficiary.
Steward records the acceptance evidence in an outcomes/<explainer-id>.json artifact with channel, URL/permalink (if applicable), and timestamp.
resources: outreach-007 (prerequisite — outreach threads must be open before a partner can be confirmed)
output: A committed partner-confirmation record (e.g. PARTNERS.md or an outcomes/<explainer-id>.json artifact) documenting the named partner, their channel, the specific explainer they have accepted, and the acceptance evidence.
